entries.zh: 落魄；落薄（衰败、陷入贫困）
entries.en: to fall into poverty; to be down and out; to decline
entries.notes: L 栏拼写残损（'a probaeca' 疑为 a pobreza），H 溥 疑为 薄；依 lo po 与 L 义定为落魄。

entries.en: to bow (lower) one's head
to lower the price; to cheapen
to lower the price; to bring down the money (price)
entries.notes: M 栏 'iog' 不明；义依 L 与 落錢。

entries.en: to let down and tend (a hanging lamp)
entries.notes: H 作 擺 而 M/R 均读 lui，疑为纍（垂下）之借字；义依 L 'servir a la lámpara'。

entries.en: to let something down (a lamp on a cord)
entries.notes: L 栏有[残]，H 第三字 城 与绳索吊灯之义不合；义据 擺落（放下）推定。

entries.en: to lower (strike) the flag
entries.notes: H/M 作 擺/lui（疑纍，垂下），L 明言 bajar la vandera、abatirla。

entries.en: to put up; to hang up (a thing)
entries.notes: H 作 擺上去（往上），与 L 的 Bajar 相反，且 L 后半残损；姑从 H/M。

entries.zh: 灾（祸自天降，如闪电骤至）
entries.en: calamity (to strike down suddenly like lightning)
entries.notes: H 有[疑:炎/災]，M/R 读 chay，当为 災。

entries.en: calamity; disaster (of hail and storm)
entries.notes: H 首字[疑:炎/災]，chay hay 即 災害。

entries.zh: 降：自天而降；贬降（身份、官爵）
entries.en: to descend (from heaven); to lower, demote (in dignity)
to descend to the mortal world (of a deity)
entries.notes: H 第二字[疑:凡/仜]，R 'guin' 对音不明；义依降凡。

entries.en: to come down; to descend
to come down into the world

entries.zh: 降痰（使痰下行）；痰涌致呛
entries.en: to bring down phlegm; to choke (on phlegm)
entries.notes: H 第二字[疑:痰/疾]，tam 对音近 痰；L 兼及 'ahogar'（呛）。

entries.en: to demote; to reduce to a lower office
to descend (from heaven); to come down
entries.notes: L 栏缀 †，或标示教义用法；H/R 均作 降臨。

entries.en: to bow one's head; to duck the head
to tumble down; to turn over and over
entries.notes: H 第三字 彜 疑残误，R 作 hien；义依 L 'dando bueltas'。

entries.en: to bow the head to the ground in reverence and love
entries.notes: H 款 与 L 的俯首至地不尽合，R 'guen' 疑为官话 跪；义据 L 推定。

entries.en: to bow the head; to knock (the head)
entries.notes: R 作 guen（疑官话 跪），与 H 叩 不合，故降一档。

entries.en: to kowtow; to bow the head in salute
